claims.statement: Local data persists in ~/.config/diffchecker-desktop/ via atomic JSON writes (temp → rename with .bak backup) guarded by a global Mutex; stores recent files (max 10), history entries (max 20, 20 MiB total, 1 MiB per side), and save_history setting; reads Electron-era camelCase keys for migration.

add_history_entry deduplicates by (original.path, original.content, changed.path, changed.content); returns status 'saved'/'disabled'/'too-large'; evicts oldest entries when total history exceeds 20 MiB.

Seven Tauri commands expose history/recent files: list_recent_files, open_recent_file, list_history, add_history, remove_history, clear_history, get/set_save_history; all capability-scoped in default.json.

Frontend useLocalData hook loads recent/history on mount, provides recordComparison/removeHistoryEntry/setSaveHistory/clearHistory actions that update local state optimistically; web fallback returns empty arrays/no-ops.

HistoryPanel (src/components/HistoryPanel.tsx) renders as a sidebar with save-history checkbox, entry list showing describe_recent_file/describe_history_side, and Restore/Remove/Clear actions; desktop-only via Toolbar toggle.
